# Deck Restaining

> Professional deck and fence restaining contractor serving Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Mississauga, Hamilton, and the Halton Region of Ontario, Canada. We use exclusively premium oil-based stains for superior penetration, no peeling, and 3–5 year durability.

## Services
- Deck Restaining — deep-penetrating oil-based stains, 3–5 year protection, no peeling
- Deck Stripping — chemical removal of failed coatings and old stains
- Deck Sanding — multi-grit professional sanding for stain absorption and smooth finish
- Full Deck Restoration — complete strip, clean, sand, and restain in one package
- Fence Staining — oil-based protection against rot, UV, and Ontario weather

## Why oil-based
We only use premium oil-based stains because they penetrate the wood fibre rather than sitting on the surface like water-based products. Oil-based finishes flex with the wood through freeze-thaw cycles and wear away gradually over 3–5 years without peeling, cracking, or flaking.
